## Description

Announcements linked to a flag and shown when the flag reaches the tenant (in-app What's new, owner email, never to patients). Planned maintenance and incident messages per region as banners in the clinic app and on the public status page (MDV-P5-018). Integrations register per country (NHCX, DHA eClaimLink, Shafafiya, Riayati, payment gateways, ABDM, WhatsApp) with status, read-only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a flag reaches a tenant, when an announcement is linked, then it shows in What's new only then.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given maintenance is scheduled for India, when the time comes, then only India practices see the banner.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the register, when is opened, then it shows each integration's status and country.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
